title: SSE_BUF_SIZE_LIMIT is hardcoded, not in ClientConfig
description: client.rs: SSE_BUF_SIZE_LIMIT (1 MiB) is a module-level const, not a field in ClientConfig. Every other limit (max_session_body, max_call_body, max_download_body, max_upload_body) is configurable. A caller who needs to allow larger SSE push notifications (e.g. servers that batch many state changes) cannot tune this without forking. Inconsistency will generate a class of issues from users who hit the limit.
